headlines.title: All Eyes on Key Midterm Primaries in Wisconsin and Minnesota
headlines.description: Voters are heading to the polls in another round of competitive primary races in the build-up to November’s midterm elections. In Wisconsin and Minnesota, Democrats will once again decide between moderate and progressive candidates. Meanwhile, in South Carolina, Republicans will pick a replacement nominee for the late Sen. Lindsey Graham. NBC’s Ryan Nobles reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump responds to Iran’s new demands
headlines.description: President Trump responded after Iran made a new set of demands before it will stop attacking commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz. NBC News’ Keir Simmons reports.

headlines.title: Watch: Videos capture the moment a 7.4-magnitude earthquake strikes Colombia
headlines.description: Watch videos captured from Colombia as a 7.4-magnitude earthquake struck the country. Casualties have been reported with many still missing amid the collapsed buildings and debris.

headlines.title: Trump signs order to change child vaccine recommendations
headlines.description: President Trump signed an executive order that would change the recommendations for childhood vaccines. He said the new recommendations give more choices to parents. But top pediatricians said it could spark dangerous confusion. NBC News’ Garrett Haake reports.

headlines.title: Tupac Murder Trial Set to Begin, Nearly 30 Years After Shooting
headlines.description: The man accused of planning the murder of Tupac Shakur is set to stand trial as prosecutors look to prove Duane "Keefe D" Davis orchestrated the drive-by shooting that killed the hip-hop legend nearly 30 years ago. Davis has spent years talking about his involvement in the case, saying he was inside the Cadillac with the gunman when shots were fired from the backseat near the Las Vegas strip. NBC’s Chloe Melas reports and senior legal correspondent Laura Jarrett joins TODAY with analysis.

headlines.title: Boat captain charged after vessel capsizes near Statue of Liberty, killing woman and her child
headlines.description: The captain of an unlicensed boat that capsized in the New York harbor near Liberty Island, killing a young mother and her baby, has been charged in their deaths. NBC News' Marquise Francis reports.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Primaries test the Democratic Party and ‘red alert’ after Colombia earthquake: Morning Rundown
headlines.description: Progressive Democrats fight for primary wins in Wisconsin and Minnesota.

headlines.title: Captain of boat that capsized near Statue of Liberty charged in deaths of mother and baby
headlines.description: Manuel Hernandez was charged with two counts of misconduct and neglect of a ship officer resulting in death in the accident, which killed Sara Sanchez, 27, and her 5-month-old daughter, Antonella Garcia.

headlines.title: Lauren Boebert’s 21-year-old son is arrested on child sexual exploitation charges
headlines.description: The allegations are linked to a video Tyler Boebert is accused of recording in 2024 with a 17-year-old.

headlines.title: Recount puts Trump-backed challenger in the lead in Indiana state Senate primary
headlines.description: State Sen. Spencer Deery, who now trails Republican Paula Copenhaver by three votes, said he will appeal.

headlines.title: Jennifer Balkcom picked to replace Rep. Chuck Edwards in N.C. congressional race
headlines.description: Edwards dropped his re-election bid after the House Ethics Committee recommended he be censured over sexual harassment allegations. He has denied any wrongdoing.
